urlCaptureRef.description: Reference from fetchUrl. Stores captured Markdown verbatim in description after any user notes, original URL in link, and web metadata. References expire after one hour or server restart; fetch again if unavailable.

title.description: The main title/name of the todo item (required). For gtd:calendar items, use scheduledTime or prefix with time in HH:MM format, e.g., "15:00 Doctor appointment".

description.description: Detailed description or notes for the todo. Can include markdown formatting

context.description: GTD context category for organizing todos (e.g. "work", "private", "errands", "shopping", "calls")

due.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the current day if not provided.

scheduledTime.description: Optional scheduled local time in HH:mm format.

scheduledTimeZone.description: Optional IANA timezone for scheduled time interpretation.

tags.description: Array of tags for categorization. Should include appropriate GTD tags (gtd:next, gtd:project, gtd:waiting, gtd:someday, gtd:calendar) based on item type.

repeat.description: Number of days to repeat this todo. Set to null (default) for no repeat. gtd:calendar repeats from original due date, gtd:habit repeats from completion date

link.description: Optional URL or reference link related to this todo. Can be used for documentation, tickets, or external resources

externalId.description: Optional external system ID for syncing (e.g., "github:owner/repo/issues/123"). Used for deduplication during periodic imports.

parentId.description: Optional parent todo ID for creating subtasks. References the _id of an existing todo to create a parent-child relationship.

blockedBy.description: Optional array of todo IDs that must complete before this task becomes actionable. Use with gtd:blocked tag for internal task dependencies. Distinct from gtd:waiting which is for external blocks.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata for extensibility. Values can be strings or arrays of strings. Use namespaced keys (e.g., "agent:worktree", "github:labels": ["bug", "priority"]).

message.description: Optional human-readable audit message describing why this todo was created (short, like a git commit message).

id.description: The unique identifier of the todo to update (ISO timestamp of creation)

title.description: Updated title/name of the todo item

due.description: Updated due date in YYYY-MM-DD format

scheduledTime.description: Updated scheduled local time in HH:mm format.

scheduledTimeZone.description: Updated IANA timezone for scheduled time interpretation.

repeat.description: Updated repeat interval in days (null to disable). gtd:calendar repeats from due date, gtd:habit repeats from completion date

link.description: Updated URL or reference link (null to remove)

externalId.description: Updated external system ID for syncing (e.g., "github:owner/repo/issues/123"). Used for deduplication during periodic imports. Set to null to remove.

parentId.description: Updated parent todo ID (null to remove parent, making it a root todo)

blockedBy.description: Updated array of todo IDs that block this task. Use with gtd:blocked tag. Set to null or empty array to remove all blockers.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata for extensibility. Values can be strings or arrays of strings. Use namespaced keys (e.g., "agent:worktree", "github:labels": ["bug", "priority"]). Replaces entire metadata object when provided.

message.description: Optional human-readable audit message describing why this update was made (short, like a git commit message).

getActiveTimeTrackingParameters.description: No parameters required - returns all todos with active time tracking

id.description: The unique identifier of the todo to start time tracking for (ISO timestamp of creation)

message.description: Optional human-readable audit message describing why time tracking was started (short, like a git commit message).

id.description: The unique identifier of the todo to stop time tracking for (ISO timestamp of creation)

message.description: Optional human-readable audit message describing why time tracking was stopped (short, like a git commit message).

docId.description: The attachment document ID to delete (e.g., 'todoId/desc/screenshot.png')

todoId.description: The unique identifier of the todo
The unique identifier of the todo

filename.description: The filename for the attachment (e.g., screenshot.png)

base64Data.description: The file content encoded as base64

contentType.description: The MIME type (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg, application/pdf)

type.description: Attachment location: 'desc' for description, 'note' for a specific note

noteId.description: Required if type is 'note': the note ID to attach to

completed.description: Filter by completion status: true for completed, false for incomplete, undefined for all

dateFrom.description: Start date filter for due date in ISO format (inclusive)

dateTo.description: End date filter for due date in ISO format (inclusive)

completedFrom.description: Start date filter for completion date in ISO format (inclusive)

completedTo.description: End date filter for completion date in ISO format (inclusive)

tags.description: Filter by specific tags (e.g., ["gtd:next"] for next actions)

externalId.description: Filter by exact external system ID (e.g., "github:owner/repo/issues/123")

parentId.description: Filter by parent todo ID to list subtasks. Use "_ROOT_" or null equivalent to list only root-level todos.

id.description: The unique identifier of the todo to toggle (ISO timestamp of creation)

completed.description: true to mark as completed, false to mark as incomplete

message.description: Optional human-readable audit message describing why this was completed/uncompleted (short, like a git commit message).

The unique identifier of the todo containing the note
